{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
{{Otheruses|Cho}}
[[File:Cho_Mok.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]] performs cho mok on his opponent's leg.]]
{{Quote|Cho mok translates as "to otherwise maim," targeting legs, limbs, or appendages that will disable your opponent.|[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
In [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], '''''cho mok''''' was the act of [[Dismemberment/Legends|cutting off]] an opponent's [[Limb/Legends|limb]].

==Application and Description==
[[File:HardinLostLeg.jpg|thumb|left|300px|[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Githany]] exacting ''cho mok'' against [[Hardin]].]]
{{Quote|We know that a severed limb can readily be replaced by a prosthetic that looks identical to the real thing. Prosthetics offer sensation and do everything flesh can. They're ideal substitutes in every way, except for requiring maintenance. So we don't feel too badly when we have to cut the arm or leg off a very bad person. But I assure you, that very bad person remembers the pain forever.|[[Valin Horn]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
''Cho mok'' was used to disable and effectively incapacitate an opponent. Often, it was used as an attack of opportunity during combat by taking advantage of an opening. [[Darksider]]s usually used this technique to bring down their opponents before ruthlessly killing them or even as a cruel form of punishment.

==Notable uses==
At the climax of the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Githany]] severed [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Hardin]]'s leg from the knee down with her [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] sliced a finger off [[Balog (Human)|Balog]] before the treacherous [[Absolutes|Absolute]] could press a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] to end [[Tahl]]'s life.<ref name="Death of Hope">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Death of Hope]]''</ref>

[[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] applied ''cho mok'' against [[Zule Xiss]], slicing off her left arm.<ref name="Republic 52">[[Republic 52|''Republic'' 52]]</ref>

[[Kass Tod]] had used ''cho mok'' on [[Alto Stratus]]'s right leg in the [[Battle of Jabiim]]<ref name="Republic 57">*[[Republic 57|''Republic'' 57]]</ref>

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] applied ''cho mok'' on an [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']].<ref name="SWROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] amputation of Darth Vader's legs and remaining arm during his ''[[Mou kei/Legends|mou kei]]'' application could be considered a fast, triple ''cho mok''.<ref name="SWROTS" /> He later used this technique against the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ponda Baba/Legends|Ponda Baba]], slicing his left arm off.<ref name="SWANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Darth Vader performed ''cho mok'' twice during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], removing [[Jambe Lu]]'s right arm as well as [[Nam Poorf]]'s right leg.<ref name="TRoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

[[Laddinare Torbin]] used this technique to sever the arm of Dark Jedi [[Arden Lyn]].<ref name="TEP">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] performed the maneuver on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] against a female [[Wampa/Legends|Wampa]], who would later be appropriately referred to as "[[One-Arm]]."<ref name="SWTESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] first performed ''cho mok'' at two years old in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], slicing the wings of a slain [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydra]] that had fallen on top of him.<ref name="CotF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref> He later chopped off [[Nelani Dinn]]'s right leg at [[Darth Vectivus]]'s lair near Bimmiel in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], beginning his path towards his grandfather's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|footsteps]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] used this technique on [[Nom Anor]] at the end of [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

Luke Skywalker also severed [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul's]] arm during their duel aboard the [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']].<ref name="Dark Nest III">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tresina Lobi]] received a cho mok strike from [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] from her [[Lumiya's lightwhip|lightwhip]], during [[Duel in the Fellowship Plaza|their duel]] in Coruscant's [[Fellowship Plaza]], having both of her legs severed at the knees.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>

[[Salle Serpa]] would have his arm cut off by [[Zekk]].<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Caedus received a ''cho mok'' strike from his own sister, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], in their duel during the [[Second Battle of Roche]].<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

[[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] pirate [[Rav]] received a ''cho mok'' strike to one of his legs from [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi [[Rasi Tuum]].<ref name="Hidden Temple 2">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>

[[Cade Skywalker]] severed the legs of the last surviving [[Unidentified horn-row Sith Lord|Sith Lord]] during the [[Mission to Daluuj]] in order to interrogate him.<ref name="Extremes 1">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref>
